name: Shapesetter
summary:
Shapesetter is an automation puzzle game in which the player programs a machine to make abstract art. Each level supplies raw shapes at its inputs and asks for finished pieces at its outputs. The player places mechanical arms on the board, fits each with a single tool for grabbing, painting, cutting, welding or drafting, and writes each arm a tape of instructions that it repeats in a loop. The machine runs until every output has received its quota.

Nothing happens out of sight: every stroke of paint, cut and weld is made by an arm the player can watch, and the shapes are exact geometry of arcs, sectors and straight edges, drawn as flat ink on a printed page. Once a level is solved, its machine is measured in cycles and in area, the ground its parts sweep across, and the player can rebuild it to be faster or smaller.
